title: Household Budget, First Quarter
key_sentences: This summary lists the spending of one household from January to March.
All amounts are in euros and rounded to the cent.
Groceries rose in March because of two family visits.
Savings were raised in February after a tax refund.
The household plans to review its transport costs in April.
